brief:
# Build pipeline v2 — one clean pipeline (Brett, Nov 7, shipped-product quality; this harness is being SOLD)

Replace the sloppy, redundant build tables/flows with ONE pipeline. Reuse existing code where it fits (orchestrator, multi-account workers PR #382, headless-progress-lean-chain, md-chain-default, claude-accounts, builds store, Shipped features feature-ledger@1). Delete what's redundant. Single profile `all` already on main.

## Flow
1. **Request → orchestrator.** Every build request (console, voice, API/MCP/CLI, planner) goes to the orchestrator only. It picks the model (Fable for contracts/schemas/shared asset types, else Opus), splits the work into steps of ≤30 min, assigns the build id, writes the brief, and puts it in **Pending**. It also creates the Shipped features entry.
2. **Pending → Queued.** One queue per Claude account. Max queued per account: setting, default 5. Orchestrator assigns the account (only accounts that can run the model and have credit; Fable needs Max).
3. **Queued → Building.** When a slot opens (parallel builds per account: Claude settings, default 3) it launches a headless session on that account and marks it Building.
4. Build table states are ONLY: **Pending, Queued, Building**. Remove every other state/table/view. Shipped features states: **Waiting → Building → Pending merge → Live**.

## Headless sessions
- Load ONLY the brief. No CLAUDE.md chain (cut CLAUDE.md to a few lines; headless skips it). Brief carries: steps, files to touch, rules for this build, done-check.
- **Brief check before queueing**: refuse to queue if any required brief field is missing.
- Session may open files on demand. If info is truly missing: write `blocked: needs X` to the progress file and stop.
- **Progress file** per build: session logs START/END of each step. Session NEVER pauses between steps. A watcher monitors progress files; on change it crosses the step off in the orchestrator. Log token usage per session and per step.
- Final required step of every build: update Shipped features.

## Blocked flow
Phone alert says what's missing → Brett answers by voice/text in AmberX, or taps "Let orchestrator decide" → orchestrator adds it to the brief and relaunches from the blocked step (done steps stay done) → orchestrator adds that info type to its brief template.

## Phone notifications (AmberX push) — every time
Session started, step done? (no — only:) session started, build finished, build failed, stopped incomplete, blocked, landed (merged to main / Live). Each opens that build. Orchestrator status updated on fail/stop. Account dies → move its builds to another account + alert.

## Landing
build_land / merge queue: discard _claude/builds sync noise automatically so finished builds never block on it; on land set Shipped features Live + alert.

## Memory
Important decisions go to the repo memory folder (_claude/memory), not claude.ai. Record today's decisions there.

## Acceptance suite (required, in CI, blocks landing)
End-to-end on a throwaway repo: request → orchestrator → ≤30-min steps → Pending→Queued→Building; per-account limits (5 queued/3 parallel) and slot-open launch; progress file crosses steps off with no stops; phone alerts on start/finish/fail/blocked/land; blocked → answer → relaunch from step; land → Shipped features Live; account dies → failover. Nothing ships unless green.

No hard-coded styling; settings through existing settings assets. Progress: append `<time> START|DONE <step>` to PROGRESS.md here at each step. Don't stop between steps. Commit, don't push.

steps.text: Cancel the Opus copy (hl-mw69nff2-7p), register this build, PROGRESS.md
Merge the reuse branches (multi-account-headless-workers #382, shipped-features-fable #364, md-chain-control incl. token-optimize + headless-progress) into claude/pipeline-v2; node tests green

pipeline@1 core contract (framework/core/pipeline.mjs): the three table states, brief check, account assignment (model → plan, credit, per-account caps), slot-open launch, failover, alert events, Shipped features state map; fixture + check-pipeline.mjs
Settings + schema: builds.maxQueuedPerAccount (5) in Claude settings, builds.maxParallel per account, framework/schemas/pipeline.json; account registry (plan, worker, limited)
Orchestrator intake: one entry (framework/cli/pipeline.mjs request) — model pick, ≤30-min split, id, brief written from the template, brief check, Pending; Shipped features entry via build-hook
Dispatcher: pipeline.mjs tick — Pending→Queued (account, cap 5), Queued→Building (parallel 3, launches claude-headless.sh --account, brief only); failover when an account dies; cron
Headless session: brief only (CLAUDE.md cut to a few lines, headless skips the chain), progress START/END per step, token usage per step, blocked: needs X
Watcher: progress file change → step crossed off in the orchestrator, status on fail/stop/blocked; pipeline.mjs watch
Blocked flow: alert with the question, answer / Let orchestrator decide (REST + MCP), brief addendum, relaunch from the blocked step, template learns the info type
Phone notifications (notify.json types pipeline.*: started, finished, failed, stopped, blocked, landed; each opens the build) raised from the dispatcher and watcher
Landing: merge queue discards _claude/builds sync noise automatically; on land Shipped features Live + alert
Console: one Pipeline view (Pending / Queued / Building) on the orchestrator page; remove the redundant build tables/views (Build manager banner, Builds page, Fable rebuilds, Pending/queue tabs)

Acceptance suite in CI: framework/spec/check-pipeline-e2e.mjs on a throwaway repo (request→…→Building, caps, slot-open launch, progress crosses off, alerts, blocked→answer→relaunch, land→Live, failover); blocks landing
Update Shipped features (required last step), THREADS.md, report, commit
